The '''Destruction of Bront''' occurred at some point before [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="CRO-4" /> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] committed atrocities on Bront that led to the destruction of the planet. [[Graf Yonna]] and his family lived on Bront by that time and only Graf survived the destruction. He later joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as an agent for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] but he remained severely traumatized by the destruction of his homeworld.<ref name="CRO-" />
